title: Expose desktop project operations
responsibility: Connects desktop project, planning, evidence and agent operations to the selected project session.

inputs.name: desktopBridge.context
inputs.description: The context supplies ProjectSessionService, ProviderDiscoveryService, DesktopRunService, a chooser returning a repository root or null, and an optional client-liveness check. The check matters before planning writes; when it is absent, that check is skipped.

outputs.name: desktopBridge
outputs.description: The proxy exposes the desktop bridge methods except onRunEvent. Methods other than openProject, selectProject, listProjects, deploymentActivities, and gameCreate assert any supplied project identity and track session.pending during execution; openProject returns null when folder selection is canceled.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Planning writes throw Error when the session is busy, the repository lease is unavailable, or the client has ended. Thread and source operations also throw Error for an unknown entity or unregistered source, and connectHosted throws Error when hosted sign-in is not configured; failures from delegated operations propagate.
